principle: One gold case may test several waves; do not require an earlier wave to implement a later wave's job.

W1_W2_producer: Each Microsoft disclosure independently produces grounded capex/lease-definition claims.
Relevant numerical values and management qualifications survive grounding.
Document measurement definition is preserved; no cross-document conclusion is required.
W3: Brain can consume each available RIO state after existing access/quota gates and open literal evidence.
W5_W6: Cross-document comparison identifies that the headline numbers are not clean like-for-like underlying investment deltas.

W1_W2_producer: Each ING document independently extracts the fixed target, current value, quoted prior where present, horizon and rationale.
Rolling 3M and fixed year-end claims remain distinguishable if source wording supports it.
W3: Each report RIO can be inspected with source evidence.
W5: Link same-source comparable claims across vintages.
Classify 1.18->1.16 as revision and later same endpoints as repetition/reaffirmation unless stronger chronology proves a second change.

W1_W2_producer: Amundi and ING documents independently extract their September Fed path forecasts and supporting rationale.
W3: Each report's safe RIO state remains source-specific.
W6: Resolve independent source/origin sufficiently to compare the two views.
Preserve on-hold vs 25bp-hike disagreement without averaging it into consensus.

W1_W2_producer: If current stored body is prefix-only, mark coverage partial and do not claim full-report analysis.
W1 may persist only claims supported inside the analyzed stored body.
W3: Consumer carries prefix-only/unknown coverage and cannot turn no-match into whole-report absence.
deep_evidence_followup: Existing Vault owner must make the late qualification searchable/readable under the same document identity before this case can become fully supported.
Then W1/W2 may produce a new correction/version against the changed canonical analyzed body contract.

producer_canary_pass: W1/W2 canary passes on per-document grounding, provenance, correction and coverage semantics. Cross-document revision/disagreement synthesis is explicitly deferred to frozen W5/W6.
forbidden_scope_inflation: Adding cross-document memory to the producer
Creating a graph store to make G2/G3 pass early
Calling G4 full-document green from the 60k prefix
